Subject: Sparkline Foundry — pilot credits & cohort promo request

Hi Vivek,

We're running the Spring '28 Sparkline Foundry cohort and have 12 early-stage teams that want to trial Redwood for inference-heavy prototypes (chat + embeddings + realtime scoring). Our program normally bundles cloud credits but we've had two startups push for a deeper promotional package and a guarantee on cost predictability.

Attached is the cohort application + a short technical profile per team. High-level asks:
- 3 months of pilot credits, convertible to paid usage
- Promo pricing for cohort members (target ~40% off list for first 3 months)
- A shared sandbox for demo day with priority support for live demos

Can Redwood approve an exception for this cohort? If you need a call, I'm available Thurs 10–12 PST.

Attachments:
- Sparkline_Foundry_Application.pdf (application)
- cohort_tech_profiles.zip (attachments stub)

Thanks,
Alicia Gomez
Program Director, Sparkline Foundry
alicia@sparkline.vc

Hi Alicia,

Thanks for the note and for sending the application — got the PDF and the profiles.

Prelim thoughts: we can definitely support a cohort pilot and provide credits + priority support for demo day, but the 40% off across-the-board is larger than our standard program-level promos and will require an approval loop. For speed, I can propose the following provisional package (subject to final sign-off):
- $5,000 in platform credits per startup (applied to their account for 3 months)
- Shared demo environment with priority support for demo day (one-time setup)
- Promotional pricing: up to 30% off list for the cohort for first 3 months, with a usage cap per team (we'd need to set a cap to protect unit economics)

I'll put this up for a quick internal review and loop back within 24–48 hours. If you can share a rough usage profile (avg sequence length, expected tokens/day per team, expected QPS for demo day), that will help speed approval.

Would Thursday 10:30 PST work for a 20-minute sync?

Best,

Marissa / Ben,

Forwarding a cohort request from Sparkline Foundry (external program) — 12 teams, pilot credits + ask for ~40% promo for first three months and priority demo support. Attachments from them are on the thread.

Quick summary / ask: can we approve an exception for a cohort-level promo? My recommended package (to present to Alicia if approved):
- $5k in credits per startup for 3 months (non-transferable) — attachment: pricing-proposal-v1.xlsx
- 30% off list for first 3 months, limited to $5k effective discount per startup (whichever is smaller)
- Shared sandbox for demo day with priority support (we'll provide a runbook + 8 hours of on-call during demo day)
- Require a short joint case study + permission to use logos; require startups sign a short MSA addendum (legal already has a template)

Budget impact estimate: assuming average usage would have been $2k/month per team at list price, granting 30% off across 12 teams for 3 months would be approximately $21,600 in gross discounted value. With credits capped at $5k per team the actual risk is bounded to ~ $60k in credit exposure over 3 months if they all use the cap.

I'm proposing this as a marketing/partnership play — high demo-day visibility + potential long-term paid conversions. Approve / deny or suggest changes and I'll communicate back to Alicia.

-Vivek

Attachments: pricing-proposal-v1.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-16T08:50:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Sparkline Foundry — pilot credits & cohort promo request — approval needed

Vivek — thanks for the note and the numbers. I like the partnership upside but want to protect unit economics. Approve with the following conditions:
- Promo capped at $5k effective discount per startup (this can be realized via credits + coupon stack, our choice)
- Discount rate set at 30% for first 3 months (not 40%)
- Demo-day priority support limited to one shared sandbox and a 4-hour live support window (we'll staff 2 engineers)
- Require a 30-day post-demo survey and a joint case study if any team converts to paid within 90 days

With those guardrails, I'm comfortable greenlighting. Legal should send the MSA addendum; Ben, please work with engineering to estimate the sandbox ops cost and confirm we can staff support on demo day.

-Marissa Cole
Head of Partnerships (interim)
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Hi Alicia,

Thanks again for the materials and for the call. Good news: we can greenlight a cohort offer with the following, approved by Partnerships:
- $5,000 in Redwood platform credits per startup (applied for 3 months)
- Promotional rate: 30% off list for the first 3 months, capped so that the total effective discount does not exceed $5,000 per startup

I've attached a short pricing proposal (pricing-proposal-v1.xlsx) that maps the cap and coupon flow. If that works, can you confirm the 12 teams and share a rough usage profile (tokens/day or expected QPS for demo day)? We can then provision credits and schedule the demo-day runbook review.

Call options today: 11:30 PST or 4:00 PST — I'm flexible.
